name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A habit pack you install for your AI coding assistant that makes it write far less code to finish the same task, cutting your AI tool's bill and the review burden.
buyer: An engineering lead at a startup watching their Claude Code / Cursor token spend climb every month.
business_use_cases: A 10-person dev team installs it across their AI coding tools to cut monthly token spend by roughly 20%.
A code-review-heavy team uses it to shrink diffs so pull requests are faster to review and merge.
An agency billing clients for AI-assisted dev work uses it to protect margins on fixed-price projects.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'cut your AI coding bill' audit: install it on a client's team, show the before/after token cost, charge for the setup and tuning.
Build a dashboard add-on that tracks and visualizes the savings over time, sold to engineering managers.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple before/after token-cost report generator teams can run once to see projected savings, then upsell the install service.
